scope: DMA mapping/quarantine and SMMU walker-cache nodes share the existing IommuNodes byte/count pool and retain the immutable original domain-grant class. Hardware completion, physical table budgets, numerical limits, the 22-pool catalog and version-9 snapshot remain unchanged.
artifact_note: Runtime Rust sources were frozen before the three campaigns. Documentation edits followed and can change tracked-diff identities; source and archived artifact hashes identify the exercised code. Signed userspace bundles were reused from the preceding consolidation; no userspace source or ABI changed.

planning.cost: 16-byte inline charge for each newly covered mapping/cache node; 8 bytes of captured class/padding in Records and a further 8 in the SMMU cache, included in actual charged domain layouts. No additional allocation holder or pool.
planning.decision: Keep numerical limits: actual empty mapping-layout byte pressure reaches 181484 ordinary and 60495 additional trusted candidates, below count ceilings and above the 65536 unified-capability planning ceiling. These are single-layout controls, not a claim that mixed or independent ceilings can be occupied together. Sharing bounds retained metadata but makes it compete with other same-class IOMMU metadata; a measured workload can justify raising central limits.
planning.completion: Quota or allocation failure returns Memory before leaf/branch publication. The existing complete pending/maintenance/domain owners retain pin, metadata and original charge through quarantine, partial sparse walks and uncertainty. Explicit confirmed cleanup unpins before metadata deallocation; deallocation precedes refund.
